But we know that about 36 other states used their federal COVID relief to pay this down, and New York did not, they chose to carry it. Of those states that weren't in that 36 that used the COVID relief, do you know where they stand? As…

We've talked about it in years past. I've talked about it with Commissioner Hiller in years past; didn't get a chance to get to it today. But in years past she had raised an issue of maybe a difficulty in defining…

recent.text: Well -- and I'm running out of time and I thank you for your answers. And I've got one more area I wanted to get to. But, you know, I think perhaps that predictability and knowing that they're going to pay more taxes in New York is leading them to leave New York because they know they're going to continue to pay more. But one positive area, an area that we worked on the last couple of years, is…

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: How can you take that position when we're losing jobs to other states and Texas has now surpassed New York on other jobs? That doesn't add up.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Well, they have more jobs in Texas than New York --

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Thanks for being with us. An area that's been a significant concern of mine in recent years is the loss of financial services jobs from the state. I think in the last two years Texas now has more financial services jobs than New York State for the first time ever. Very concerning.
